verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for an immigration-management SaaS platform, but the evidence never describes acting on many cases or employees at once. The closest items are a company-wide overview of mobility activity via the immigration tab and consolidating operations in one place. These are visibility and consolidation features, not bulk actions, and no API or OpenAPI spec was found that could support batch work.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
